title: Singapore + Seoul Dedicated Capacity launch: instance types, flexible commitments & release notes coordination
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: coordinate cross-functional work to launch Dedicated capacity in Singapore (asia-southeast1) and Seoul (asia-northeast3) with two new Ampere instance types (rdi-a1-highmem, rdi-a2-standard) and a flexible reservation tier (FlexCommit) that allows burst overage billing. This ticket covers launch readiness, release notes, sales enablement collateral, billing SKU updates, console UX copy, and risk mitigation for customer migrations.

Goals:
- Have GA release notes and in-console rollout available at regional launch.
- Ensure billing SKUs and pricing table updates are live in both marketplace and customer invoices.
- Enable Sales & SE with playbook + migration checklist.
- Implement runbook for support for initial 30-day ramp.

Success metrics:
- <50 customer-reported upgrade blockers in first 14 days.
- Sales/SE trained with playbook and 10 demo runs by launch.
- Billing reconciliation complete with Finance within 7 days post-launch.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted, approved by Legal and Security, and published to docs.redwood.ai before public announcement
Console region drop-down and instance-type UI validated in staging and smoke-tested with end-to-end provisioning
Billing SKUs created in billing system and verified against pricebook mapping
SE playbook and migration runbook shared with Sales and Support; at least two SE-led dry runs completed
Rollback plan and capacity fallback policy documented and tested
checklist: Coordinate final PR for release-notes/md with Docs (owner: Priya Rao)
Legal sign-off on terms for FlexCommit overage policy (owner: Amira Khan)
Finance create SKUs and update pricebook (owner: Diego Martinez)
Console strings update and localization for en/ko/zh (owner: UX Team)
Create Support runbook + escalation matrix (owner: Rahul Desai)
Prepare incident playbook for quota exhaustion and fallback to compatible instance families (owner: Reliability)
Schedule Sales/SE training sessions and record playbook demo (owner: Liam O'Neill)
Verify infra autoscaling and burst policies in dedicated pools (owner: ENG-infra)
Tag customers in pilot cohort and send migration invites (owner: Customer Success)
release_notes_draft: Planned release (Dedicated: asia-southeast1, asia-northeast3) introduces two new Ampere-backed instance types (rdi-a1-highmem, rdi-a2-standard) optimized for cost-sensitive generative workloads and a new Flexible Commitment (FlexCommit) reservation option. Highlights: flexible monthly commitments with controlled burst overage rates, in-console reservation management, and automatic routing to compatible instance types on capacity constraints. Migration guidance and FAQ included. Launch date: 2026-04-10 (subject to final QA).
messaging_snippets: Customer-facing headline: Lower your inference spend with new Ampere instances and FlexCommit—dedicated capacity now in Singapore & Seoul.

Email teaser for pilot customers: We're launching Dedicated capacity in Singapore & Seoul with a new flexible reservation option. Interested in early migration assistance? Reply to this email to join the pilot.
Sales one-liner: Offer predictable performance with Reserved capacity or reduce upfront commitment with FlexCommit; we provide automated fallbacks and migration tools.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pilot) 2026-03-20 to 2026-03-31: Invite pilot customers (10) and run migration tests. Phase 1 (Staged GA) 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-09: Enable region for new accounts and select customers, monitor metrics and scaling behavior. Phase 2 (Public GA) 2026-04-10: Public announcement, docs live, enable self-serve purchases. Post-launch 30-day monitoring with daily SLO dashboard and weekly sync. A/B routing policy enabled to divert 5% traffic to fallback instance family during first week to validate fallbacks.
